about_the_game:
A Little Bit Difficult.

This is a game where you control a diced steak and aim for the goal located deep within each stage.

But it’s not just any diced steak. This steak has the power to create ghosts. These ghosts replicate your past actions and can be strategically used to overcome obstacles. There are two types of ghosts:

  • One that you can create at any time

  • One that appears when you die and replays your previous run

As a steak, touching a hot iron plate will cook you. If you get too cooked and become burnt to a crisp, you’ll be discarded. Well-done is nice and all, but try to make it through while staying as rare as possible.
・Play Time

Approximately 1–5 hours (depending on difficulty and player skill)

・Stage

Only one large stage, composed of six distinct areas.
There are 14 checkpoints throughout the stage.

・Selectable Difficulties (4 levels)

  • EASY

  • NORMAL

  • HARD

  • 1STEAK

(The skin you unlock upon clearing changes depending on the selected difficulty.)

Essential Techniques

・Double Jump

Start recording a ghost just as you jump, then stop the recording at the peak of your jump and immediately spawn the ghost. By jumping right as the ghost collides with your steak, you can perform a double jump. With skill, even triple or quadruple jumps are possible.

・Smash Action

The smash action greatly improves your control. It provides posture correction and downward force, allowing you to land more accurately. Even if you slightly miss a platform, you can sometimes recover using this action.

Video & Streaming Guidelines

Recording and streaming are allowed. Monetization is also permitted.
